name: Xybernetex Supervisor for OpenClaw
description: Agent supervisor with observation and opt-in local tool restrictions.

approvalDescription.description: Operator-written action, target and risk shown to the reviewer; do not put secrets here.

paramsMatch.description: Exact, case-sensitive matches on the specified string parameters. Omit to match every call to this tool for the selected agent.

riskAtLeast.description: Match only calls src/risk.js classifies at or above this tier (e.g. any destructive exec command, not just one exact command). Combines with paramsMatch (both must hold) when both are set. A tool risk.js doesn't know how to judge never matches, even in enforce mode - it is skipped, not treated as low risk.

endpoint.description: Full URL of the Xybernetex policy endpoint, e.g. https://<worker>.workers.dev/evaluate

apiKey.description: Bearer key for the endpoint. Prefer the XYBERNETEX_API_KEY environment variable, which takes precedence.

maxToolCallsPerRun.description: Tool-call budget per agent run that the policy reasons against (both its step and cost budget).

logPath.description: JSONL log of every snapshot and decision. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/xybernetex-supervisor.jsonl.
